{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''How to Succeed in Everything''''' was a bestselling memoir written by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and published in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]]. It included a discussion of his encounters with [[Rokur Gepta]], a [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerer of Tund]]. An excerpt of this account was included in a section on the Sorcerers in [[Tionne Solusar]]'s [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force|written work]] on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
